definitions: A set of colors that are unprocessed or in their original state, often referring to the full range of colors available in a digital image or display before any adjustments or enhancements.
A collection of unmixed or primary colors used by an artist.
examples: The camera captured a raw palette of vibrant hues.
She preferred to work with a raw palette, mixing her own shades.
The software displayed the image's raw palette for editing.
